verdict.rationale: MailerSend's developer docs state that it offers official libraries for multiple programming languages, so developers can build against first-party SDKs for its API. The evidence is a single statement that does not name the languages or describe what the SDKs cover. Missing for 10: the specific list of SDK languages, evidence of SDK feature coverage across the API surface (SMS, WhatsApp, webhooks, etc.), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: MailerSend supports this list of official libraries for your favorite programming language.
